title: ticks' sandbox image never reaps orphans: PID 1 is the Node control server and every killed orphan stays a zombie forever
body: Reproduced while fixing tick 58z: in the deployed factory image (base cloudflare/sandbox:0.12.7-python, ENTRYPOINT /container-server/sandbox), an orphaned, SIGKILLed child reparents to PID 1 and remains State: Z indefinitely — the control server never wait()s. Over a long orchestrator run, every timed-out gate and cancelled worker leaves permanent zombies (pid slots and kernel process-table entries). ticks owns the image tree (vendored here at image/ via sandbox.pin.json, never edited here); wrapping the control server with a reaping init (tini) or reaping in the server would close it for every container this factory boots.
